_comment: Sample catalog for the Artist Shop Template. Replace with your own exhibits and artworks: 1) drop images into public/art/ (+ 900px thumbnails in public/art/thumbs/), 2) add an exhibit object below, 3) add artwork objects pointing at it. Then run: node scripts/build.js

artworks.blurb: The harbor wakes in layers of gold — masts and rooftops dissolving into the first light of day.
artworks.title: Dawn Harbor

artworks.blurb: Mist lifts off the still water in silver veils; the far shore is only a rumor of trees.
artworks.title: Morning Mist

artworks.blurb: Sunlight shatters across the waves — a thousand gold coins scattered on indigo.
artworks.title: Scattered Sun

artworks.blurb: The skyline reduces to rhythm — amber towers keeping time against a violet dusk.
artworks.title: Dusk Towers

artworks.blurb: Neon and headlights smear into color on rain-wet streets; the city dreams in magenta.
artworks.title: Rain Neon

artworks.blurb: The city from above: interlocking blocks of amber and sage, split by a river of molten light.
artworks.title: Golden Grid

exhibits.description: Three studies of first light on water — a harbor dissolving into gold, mist lifting off a still lake, sunlight shattering across the waves. Replace this exhibit with your own body of work.
exhibits.subtitle: Dawn studies in water and light
exhibits.title: First Light

exhibits.description: Three urban visions — towers keeping time at dusk, neon smeared on rain-wet streets, the city grid glowing from above. Replace this exhibit with your own body of work.
exhibits.subtitle: The city, reduced to rhythm and color
exhibits.title: City Geometry
